annotations.title: Compare HUD, bank, debt fund and LIHTC construction financing

description: Side-by-side rules for financing apartment construction four ways: HUD 221(d)(4), a bank construction loan, a debt fund and 4% tax credits with bonds. For each: maximum loan size and the rule behind it, rate type, term, coverage test, extra costs and process, with the regulation or HUD letter cited.

programs.description: Which to include; omit for all four.
